target_state_suggestion.rationale: X25519MLKEM768 is a PQ/T hybrid key agreement group defined in RFC 10024. Components, in shared-secret order (RFC 10024, Section 4.3): ML-KEM-768, X25519. RFC 10024, Section 5 (informal notes on NIST guidance): "In contrast, for X25519MLKEM768, the ML-KEM implementation must be certified." The identifier does not show whether the ML-KEM-768 implementation is certified. Human review of certification evidence is required.
